ledger_head.description: upstream run-ledger chain head — seeds this stage entry prev; empty = recover the ai-sdlc:ledger-head marker on the PR (issue #196)

main_guard.description: sentinel switch — true|false; empty = .ai-sdlc.yaml merge.main_guard.enabled (default true)

main_guard_workflows.description: csv gate workflow names — override; empty = .ai-sdlc.yaml merge.main_guard.workflows (default ci)

max_repairs.description: repair rounds before escalation — override; -1 = .ai-sdlc.yaml merge.max_repairs

merge_method.description: squash | merge | rebase — override; empty = .ai-sdlc.yaml merge.method

org_config.description: org baseline contract ref owner/repo[/path][@ref] — org floor per spec/org-policy.md; empty = repo contract + defaults

pending_max_minutes.description: pending-checks cap before escalation — override; -1 = .ai-sdlc.yaml merge.pending_max_minutes

review_wait_minutes.description: pending-review cap before merging with review_timeout — override; -1 = .ai-sdlc.yaml review.wait_max_minutes

runtime_ref.description: ref of os-santiago/ai-sdlc to fetch trusted runtime scripts (main-guard.js, alert-router.js) from — pin to the same ref as this workflow

ledger_head.description: sealed run-ledger chain head for this gate run (issue #196)

main_guard.description: halt | cleared | ok — base-branch sentinel result (issue #189)

AI_SDLC_APP_ID.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App id — mints the per-run installation token used for all gh auth (fail-closed when unset; issue #26)

AI_SDLC_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App private key (PEM) — pairs with AI_SDLC_APP_ID

AI_SDLC_LEDGER_KEY.description: run-ledger signing key (PEM; Ed25519/RSA) — seals stage evidence; absent = unsigned seal (issue #196)
